phone.notes: A Digimon sent back to its bracelet storage is rebuilt in storage if its copy was missing, instead of being lost. Custom cards written to a bracelet with the number of another card are recognised. Reading a bracelet twice no longer duplicates the Digimon. The scan buttons say bracelet. Requires Android 13 or newer.

watch.notes: The watch no longer uses NFC: Digimon come from the phone and go back with TRANSFER, then BACK TO FARM.
